import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class b {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FS in = new FS(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (n > m) {
            int t = n;
            n = m;
            m = t;
        }

        out.println(solve(n, m));
        out.close();
    }

    private static long solve(int n, int m) {
        if (n > 2) {
            return (long) n * m / 2 * 2;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            return m / 6 * 6 + 2 * Math.max(m % 6 - 3, 0);
        }
        switch (m) {
            case 2:
                return 0;
            case 3:
                return 4;
            case 7:
                return 12;
            default:
                return 2 * m;
        }
    }

    static class FS {
        BufferedReader in;
        StringTokenizer token;

        FS(InputStream str) {
            in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(str));
        }

        String next() {
            if (token == null || !token.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    token = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
                } catch (IOException ex) {
                }
                return next();
            }
            return token.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }
}

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class b {
    private static final int BUFSIZE = 1 << 15;
    private static final InputStream IN = new BufferedInputStream(System.in);
    private static byte[] buf = new byte[BUFSIZE];
    private static int idx;
    private static int size;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int n = nextInt();
        int m = nextInt();

        if (n > m) {
            n ^= m;
            m ^= n;
            n ^= m;
        }

        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        if (n > 2) {
            out.println((long) n * m / 2 * 2);
        } else if (n == 1) {
            out.println(m / 6 * 6 + 2 * Math.max(m % 6 - 3, 0));
        } else if (m == 2) {
            out.println(0);
        } else if (m == 3) {
            out.println(4);
        } else if (m == 7) {
            out.println(12);
        } else {
            out.println(2 * m);
        }
        out.close();
    }

    private static int nextInt() throws IOException {
        int c;
        do {
            c = read();
        } while (c <= ' ' && c != -1);

        boolean negative = false;
        if (c == '+' || c == '-') {
            negative = (c == '-');
            c = read();
        }

        int value = 0;
        while (c > ' ' && c != -1) {
            value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        }
        return negative ? -value : value;
    }

    private static int read() throws IOException {
        if (idx >= size) {
            size = IN.read(buf);
            idx = 0;
            if (size <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf[idx++] & 0xff;
    }
}
